verdict.rationale: MotherDuck supports local/in-memory DuckDB development (via CLI or local MCP server) that lets an agent run real analytical queries with zero MotherDuck account or production data touched, and offers read-only restriction and SaaS Mode to limit AI/agent access to local environment before syncing to cloud (docs-18, docs-31, docs-9, probe-rt-2). However, there is no dedicated 'sandbox' or database-branching feature that clones or isolates production data for testing—developers must manually use local files or in-memory DBs instead. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/branch/clone-of-production feature, first-party guidance framing this as a test-vs-prod workflow, and independent confirmation of safe isolation from prod data.
